title: Big sites start blocking AI agents
body: Yelp, Delta Air Lines, JPMorgan Chase and Charles Schwab now block AI agents; Cars.com and Amtrak quietly followed. Yelp only lets in agents that pay for its data licensing. https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1013195/ai-agents-blocked-web
